records.source: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Demetrius 64 18 0/pause 1500/speak Demetrius "Hi @! I have some good news for you. A few days ago I made a breakthrough in my research on the local environment.$h#$b#I'll spare you the technical details and get to the point... You know that empty cave you have, over in the cliffs?#$b#Well, I have a way to turn it into something useful... for both of us.#$b#I'd like to set up the cave to attract some local species. That way I can observe them in a more controlled environment. And you can harvest whatever products they produce.#$b#I can either set up the cave to attract mushrooms or fruit bats. The bats will sometimes leave fruit for you to collect."/cave/speak Demetrius "Alright! I'll go set it up for you right now! It shouldn't take any time at all.$h#$b#Thanks for letting me do this."/end dialogue Demetrius "I'm excited to see what happens with that cave. Aren't you?#$e#I hope you're pleased with the work I did."
records.translation: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Demetrius 64 18 0/pause 1500/speak Demetrius "Kumusta, @! May magandang balita ako. Ilang araw na ang nakalipas, nagkaroon ako ng mahalagang tuklas sa pagsasaliksik ko sa kapaligiran dito.$h#$b#Hindi ko na sasabihin ang mga teknikal na detalye at tutungo na ako sa punto... Alam mo ang bakanteng yungib sa gawing bangin?#$b#May paraan akong gawin itong kapaki-pakinabang... para sa ating dalawa.#$b#Gusto kong ayusin ang yungib upang makahikayat ng ilang lokal na uri ng organismo. Sa gayon ay mamamasdan ko sila sa mas kontroladong kapaligiran. At maaari mong anihin ang anumang produktong ibibigay nila.#$b#Maaari kong ayusin ang yungib upang makahikayat ng mga kabute o mga paniking kumakain ng prutas. Paminsan-minsan ay mag-iiwan ng prutas ang mga paniki para kolektahin mo."/cave/speak Demetrius "Sige! Aayusin ko na iyon para sa iyo ngayon din! Hindi ito magtatagal.$h#$b#Salamat sa pagpapahintulot na gawin ko ito."/end dialogue Demetrius "Nasasabik akong makita ang mangyayari sa yungib na iyon. Ikaw rin ba?#$e#Sana ay nasiyahan ka sa ginawa ko."

records.source: pause 400/speak Harvey "Sorry I'm all disheveled... I didn't know you were coming over.$h"/move farmer 0 -2 0/pause 600/speak Harvey "Hey, I think I hear a plane overhead..."/move Harvey 0 1 3/move Harvey -3 0 0/move Harvey 0 -2 0/speak Harvey "@, get over here!"/move farmer 0 -1 3/move farmer -4 0 0/move farmer 0 -2 0/speak Harvey "Look!"/globalFade/cutscene plane/viewport -1000 -1000/speak Harvey "As a kid, my dream was always to be a pilot."/pause 1000/speak Harvey "...But with my bad eyesight and a crippling fear of heights, that dream started to fade away.$s"/faceDirection Harvey 3/faceDirection farmer 1/viewport 5 6 true/pause 1000/emote farmer 28/speak Harvey "It's okay... don't be sad.#$b#I've grown to accept my station in life. records.source: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Gunther 64 18 0/broadcastEvent/rustyKey/skippable/pause 1500/speak Gunther "Oh, good morning ${Mr.^Ms.}$ @!#$b#I hope it's not too early...$s#$b#Well, I just wanted to stop by and thank you in person for all the wonderful artifacts and minerals you've discovered... you've done so much for one person!$h#$b#In fact, I've just received a letter from the office of the regional secretary of artifacts... We're being honored with the coveted 'golden shovel' award for our significant contributions to the field!#$b#And it's all thanks to you!$h#$b#Well, I should let you get back to your work..."/pause 500/faceDirection Gunther 2/pause 700/emote Gunther 16/faceDirection Gunther 0/speak Gunther "Oh! I almost forgot!#$b#I have a gift for you... It's an old key that's been sealed in the museum vault for at least 100 years. It's a little rusty, but still beautiful.$h"/pause 500/pause 500/playSound reward/message "You got the 'Rusty Key'! It's been added to your wallet."/pause 500/end
records.translation: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Gunther 64 18 0/broadcastEvent/rustyKey/skippable/pause 1500/speak Gunther "O, magandang umaga, ${G.^Bb.}$ @!#$b#Sana ay hindi pa masyadong maaga...$s#$b#Dumaan lang ako upang personal kang pasalamatan sa lahat ng kahanga-hangang artifact at mineral na natuklasan mo... napakarami mong nagawa nang mag-isa!$h#$b#Sa katunayan, katatanggap ko lang ng liham mula sa tanggapan ng panrehiyong kalihim ng mga artifact... Pararangalan tayo ng inaasam na gantimpalang 'Ginintuang Pala' dahil sa mahahalagang ambag natin sa larangan!#$b#At lahat ng iyon ay salamat sa iyo!$h#$b#Dapat hayaan na kitang bumalik sa trabaho mo..."/pause 500/faceDirection Gunther 2/pause 700/emote Gunther 16/faceDirection Gunther 0/speak Gunther "O! Halos makalimutan ko!#$b#May regalo ako sa iyo... Isa itong lumang susi na nakasara sa imbakan ng museo nang hindi bababa sa 100 taon. Medyo kinakalawang, pero maganda pa rin.$h"/pause 500/pause 500/playSound reward/message "Nakuha mo ang 'Kalawangin na Susi'! Idinagdag ito sa iyong pitaka."/pause 500/end
